confidence_boundary: The source path and battle-object owner field are confirmed for the observed clean-launch tutorial/story battle path. Normal non-tutorial and alternate scripted paths still require separate lifecycle confirmation before Task 2 can mark Gate ownership globally confirmed.

derivation_path.operation: Load the central battle-session pointer through global holder 0x020D433C.
Use the selected-combatant descriptor for the fixed second participant slot to read an arena-placement entry index from session + 0x8D + participant_index * 20.
Index the arena-placement table at session + 0x1C + arena_entry_index * 8.
Read placement byte +0 as the owner's Gate-slot index and placement byte +1 as the Gate-owner participant index.
Store the owner participant index into battle object +0x06.
Select the owner participant object through session +0x0C + owner_index * 4.
Read the active Gate ID from owner participant object +0x54 + gate_slot_index * 4 and store it into battle object +0x04.

instruction_evidence.purpose: constructor zero-initializes active Gate ID and owner fields
derive owner and Gate ID from arena-placement and participant objects
literal reference to central session pointer holder 0x020D433C

supported_conclusions: The active Gate owner is not encoded by session +0x28D/+0x28E.
The authoritative owner source for the observed path is arena-placement entry byte +1.
Battle object +0x06 is the battle-local copy of that owner participant index.
Battle object +0x04 is the battle-local active Gate ID derived from the owner's Gate-slot table.
Gate ownership can be resolved without scanning both participants' complete Gate inventories once the battle object has been constructed.
The owner field is initialized to zero at constructor entry and assigned before any Gate bonus lookup occurs.
unresolved: Whether normal non-tutorial battles use the same arena-placement table and battle-object +0x06 field
Whether scripted battles can directly override battle object +0x04 or +0x06
The mutation and reset behavior of the arena-placement owner byte before battle construction
Whether battle object +0x06 remains valid through Gate capture and result processing
The exact semantics of session +0x28D/+0x28E beyond fixed participant/combatant ordering

next_checkpoint.objective: Confirm owner-field lifetime and reset behavior through result/capture, and verify that normal or alternate scripted construction does not bypass the arena-placement owner path.
